title: Every rule CI enforces is a scoped brain record
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16: "agenci nie znają reguł z repozytorium" — tonight most PRs needed 2-4 CI rounds on rules the repo already enforces (biome on JSON, task-quality, spec/receivers.json, shard weights, standards-proposals test, Proof `cmd: verdict`, weak-tests line).
Outcome: every check that npm run lint, npm run check and the CI test jobs run maps to one enforced standards record with its path scope, served by the edit-time moment; a test fails when a CI check has no record.
Proof: `node --test test/brain/ci-rule-coverage.test.ts` passes with 0 unmapped checks.
Files: .agents/records.json, src/brain/standards.ts
